params.body:
The record on the trend page and in the agent door: how much of everything the Observatory saw in each month touched this trend, since it started watching.

Projected with the card (pipeline alongside), stored on `trend_cards.recurrence`, drawn by `<x-record>`: one bar per month scaled by the SHARE of that month's intake, the month in progress drawn pale and left out of the verdict, both numbers in every bar's title because a figure without its source does not exist. Under it one sentence: "Seen 1,840 times since 11 March 2026: 0.7% of everything we saw in August, and rising." The month quoted is the last COMPLETE one, since naming a third of a month turns a true number into a false impression.

**Open on every plan, deliberately.** It is the argument for buying one, not a thing behind the till. What stays paid is WHICH sources; how often we saw it is the shop window. It travels in the shared shape, so the REST API and the MCP tools carry it identically, and the server instructions and `llms.txt` now tell an agent to quote the record over the totals when the question is whether something is real or growing.

Four tests, and a Blade lesson worth keeping: a directive glued to the word before it is not a directive but text, and the compiled view then carries an `@endif` with nothing to close. Suite 268 green, Pint and the Tailwind lint clean.

Needs `php artisan migrate --force` on the box, as usual, and one `reconcile:projection` to fill the column.
params.title: The record on the trend and in the agent door
